title: Privacy Notice
intro: This notice explains how {business} collects and uses personal information when you visit this website, send us an enquiry or ask us to arrange a site visit.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: {business} is a home improvement and property renovation business serving Glasgow and surrounding areas. We are responsible for the personal information described in this notice. You can contact us by phone on {phone}{emailSentence}.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: When you use our enquiry or site visit form, call us or message us, we may collect:
list: your name, email address and phone number
your postcode or the address of the property
details about your project, including your preferred start date
photos you choose to upload of your space
any other information you include in your messages to us

sections.heading: How we use it
list: to reply to your enquiry and answer your questions
to arrange and carry out a site visit or consultation
to prepare a quotation and, if you go ahead, to carry out and manage the work
to keep records we need for accounting and legal reasons
after: We use this information because you have asked us to provide a quotation or service (taking steps before entering into a contract, and performing that contract), because we have a legitimate interest in responding to enquiries and running our business, and where we must comply with legal obligations.
We do not sell your information or use it for unrelated marketing.

sections.heading: Services we use
paragraphs: We use trusted third-party services to run this website and our business. They handle information on our behalf:
list: Tally, which provides our online enquiry forms and stores what you submit
TradieHQ, which we use to prepare quotations
WhatsApp, if you choose to message us there
after: Each of these services has its own privacy policy explaining how it protects information.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: This website does not use advertising or analytics cookies. The embedded enquiry form is provided by Tally, which may use cookies or similar technologies needed for the form to work. Please see Tally’s privacy policy for details.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your information only for as long as we need it to deal with your enquiry, provide a quotation and complete any work, and for as long as we are required to keep business records by law.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to ask for a copy of the information we hold about you, and to ask us to correct it, delete it or limit how we use it. You can also object to how we use it. To make a request, contact us using the details above.
If you are unhappy with how we have handled your information, you can complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk. We would appreciate the chance to put things right first.

sections.heading: Changes to this notice
paragraphs: We may update this notice from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
